channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Fed’s preferred gauge showed core inflation at 3.0% in August, much lighter than expected
item.description: The personal consumption expenditures price index was projected to show an annual gain of 3.7% on headline and 3.3% for core, according to the Dow Jones consensus.

item.title: FTC is investigating OpenAI, Anthropic and other AI companies over product risks
item.description: The probe adds to the mounting scrutiny that OpenAI and Anthropic have been facing over their safety practices following the Hugging Face hack.

item.title: Inside Man: How Chinese spies used lies, love and betrayal to target the Federal Reserve
item.description: A CNBC investigation shows how former Fed advisor John Rogers became entangled with a man U.S. officials identify as a Chinese intelligence operative.

item.title: DOJ accuses Minnesota federal judges of misconduct for NY Times immigration interviews
item.description: The Department of Justice seeks the recusal of the judges who spoke to The New York Times from any cases involving the Department of Homeland Security.

item.title: Eli Lilly says closely watched combo obesity regimen boosts weight loss in mid-stage trial
item.description: Lilly said it plans to start Phase 3 trials on the combo regimen adding its amylin drug eloralintide to tirzepatide at the end of the year.

item.title: These two chip stocks could join the elite $2 trillion tech giant club, says top analyst
item.description: Resurgent CPUs and efficiency gains from memory could propel more chipmakers to a $2 trillion market cap.

item.title: Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick reports more than $250 million in income last year
item.description: Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick unwound his ties to Cantor Fitzgerald as the billionaire financier joined the Trump administration.

item.title: Trump's latest global tariffs face trade court challenge
item.description: The Trump administration says the tariffs respond to countries failing to effectively ban the trade of goods produced using forced labor practices.

item.title: Senate expected to vote on stock trading ban, data center bill before election recess
item.description: The Senate will vote on bills that would ban members from trading stocks while in office, and to address data center-related utility costs, amid Democratic opposition.

item.title: Stellantis CEO reconfirms 2026 guidance, says turnaround plan continues as automaker's shares hit new low
item.description: Stellantis CEO Antonio Filosa on Wednesday reconfirmed the company's 2026 guidance and its plans to be cash flow positive by 2027.

item.title: Treasury launches student loan support center as new data show 9.3 million borrowers in default
item.description: The Trump administration announced on Wednesday that it was launching a "Default Loans Support Center" for student loan borrowers who've fallen behind.

item.title: Trump administration starts sending $500 Obamacare refund checks — who stands to benefit
item.description: The refunds come after millions of people lost premium subsidies for their health insurance, and right before the midterm elections.

item.title: Passengers overcame pilot who tried to crash Flydubai flight, Israel says
item.description: The co-pilot of a Flydubai plane has been arrested after he tried to crash a flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv before being subdued by passengers.

item.title: Kalshi, Polymarket trading volumes on some products raises questions amid massive growth
item.description: Unusual trading patterns on Kalshi and Polymarket are drawing scrutiny as experts debate whether reported volumes reflect organic market activity.

item.title: Private sector jobs rose by 90,000 in September, better than expected, ADP reports
item.description: Private job creation picked up in September after a brief slowdown.

item.title: Trump's meeting with tech leaders leaves AI safety more unsettled than ever
item.description: Following Trump's lunch with artificial intelligence leaders at the White House, the industry remains largely unchanged on AI safety.

item.title: The market search for balance sheet 'cash cows' and 'quality' stocks is changing
item.description: With AI spending consuming the cash of the market's richest companies, balance sheet metrics led by free cash flow are getting more investing attention.

item.title: 'Super intelligence is a national security issue,' Jay Clayton says; dodges AI 'czar' question
item.description: A media report this week said President Donald Trump stated that Clayton, the director of national intelligence, would make a good AI czar.

item.title: Applied Materials just broke out above a key level. This bullish options trade takes advantage
item.description: Look at a bull put spread to bet on continued upside toward our $615 target while keeping the risk limited.

item.title: OpenAI follows Meta into the red-hot market for personal agents. But will users pay?
item.description: Following Meta's blockbuster release of its Muse AI agent earlier this month, OpenAI jumped into the personal agent market with Dots.

item.title: Nvidia is approaching a breakout level. Plus, what we want to see from Micron
item.description: The Investing Club holds its "Morning Meeting" every weekday at 10:20 a.m. ET.

item.title: Haven’t hit your 2026 money goals yet? These tools can help you build a savings plan
item.description: Behind on your 2026 savings goal? The right budgeting app and high-yield savings account can help you get back on track.

item.title: Ken Griffin pledges $3 billion to Carnegie Mellon University in 'historic' gift
item.description: Citadel CEO Ken Griffin is committing $3 billion to Carnegie Mellon University, a "historic" gift that includes $2 billion to establish a new Miami campus.

item.title: Mattel names Roger Lynch as CEO, replacing Ynon Kreiz
item.description: Mattel announced on Wednesday that Roger Lynch would serve as CEO and Chairman, replacing Ynon Kreiz.

item.title: Trump denies offering Iran sanctions relief; Tehran receives U.S. proposal following Qatar talks
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump has denied reports that he had offered sanctions relief to Iran in exchange for concessions from Tehran on its nuclear program.

item.title: Tennis star Jessica Pegula says helping her family run the Buffalo Bills could be in her future
item.description: Tennis star Jessica Pegula says she's open to helping her family run the Buffalo Bills after her playing career is over.

item.title: Micron earnings hit Wall Street after the bell. Here's how options traders are positioned into the report
item.description: In the near term, the market needs to get through Micron earnings. The good news is options traders think it could be a slam dunk.

item.title: Robinhood unveils weekend hours, AI agents to allow users to trade nonstop
item.description: Robinhood is broadening its offerings in a bid for more active traders who may be seeking trading access beyond traditional U.S. stock market hours.

item.title: Holiday retail sales are expected to top $1 trillion as inflation boosts growth
item.description: Holiday retail sales are expected to grow this holiday season and top $1 trillion for the first time, though that growth is boosted by inflation.

item.title: Parents who want to help their kids in a tough job market should avoid this 1 move, says career expert
item.description: Some well-meaning career advice from parents is "totally useless" for new grads today, according to journalist Jodi Kantor.
